coverage.note: The repository contains additional NPC/vendor catalogs. Product-level rows for restricted categories are intentionally excluded. The data-element schema and shared runtime engine rules still apply to those vendor classes.

VendorDefinition.title: Vendor title passed to BaseVendor.
VendorDefinition.additional_services: Non-catalog services implemented by the NPC.

InventoryGroupDefinition.row_order_preserved: Whether source ordinal order is preserved.
InventoryGroupDefinition.duplicate_rows_preserved: Whether duplicate item types remain separate rows.
InventoryGroupDefinition.inactive_source_rows: Commented/TODO rows retained only as metadata.

BuyOfferDefinition.row_order: Ordinal within the SBInfo BuyInfo list.
BuyOfferDefinition.name_override: Explicit localized/string name override, if supplied.
BuyOfferDefinition.hue: Constant hue when source uses a constant.
BuyOfferDefinition.hue_expression: Runtime hue expression when source evaluates one.
BuyOfferDefinition.constructor_args: Arguments required by the entity factory.
BuyOfferDefinition.control_slots: Follower/control slots required for mobile purchases.
BuyOfferDefinition.active: Whether the source row is active code.

BuybackRuleDefinition.base_player_sell_price: Base gold paid to the player.
BuybackRuleDefinition.resellable: GenericSellInfo considers listed transferable types resellable.

VendorRuntimeState.resale_entries: Actual player-sold item instances kept in BuyPack.

ResaleEntry.item_instance: Actual item instance rather than virtual stock record.

load_sequence: append every SBInfo.BuyInfo and SBInfo.SellInfo in source order

purchase.stackable_behavior: one created entity receives purchased amount
purchase.nonstackable_behavior: one created entity per purchased unit
purchase.fallback_if_backpack_rejects_item: move created entity to buyer world location

payment.bank_behavior: if total cost >= 2000 and backpack cannot pay the full total, attempt the full total from bank

resale.decay_check: performed when VendorBuy scans player-sold items

persistence.compatibility_risk: reordering SBInfo or BuyInfo rows changes the ordinal key used by legacy persistence
